**A test build for the Canadian Ioniq 6 (CEEV) on 260903.** This is a fork build, not
an Open-HMG release. It is Open-HMG's 2.2.0-rc.4 (the Wi-Fi hotspot asked of HMG-API,
the shared CarPlay identity, the Ioniq 6 on 260206) plus the CEEV Canada 260903 head unit.

**It is signed with a different author key** (`6ed33151-8b1f-8033-b3a5-5e1134ead3fa`)
than Open-HMG's mod (`7251ce71-…`). HMG-API only updates a mod from the key it was
installed with, so an installed Open-HMG `wireless-carplay-aa` has to be removed first
(its settings are lost; nothing else is). **It needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer** (the
hotspot ask). The fork's HMG-API build with the Ioniq 6 CAN 260903 map is needed too:
Open-HMG's has no map for this head unit, so the menu hook
(`btsettings.projection_helper.open_wireless_page`) stays off there.

## What changed

- **Wireless CarPlay firewall rules (rc.7).** The Ioniq 6's whitelist firewall allows the
  CarPlay ports (5000-5001, 5020, 6000-6003, 6011, 6020, 6030-6031, 7000) only on the wired
  link, and nothing at all for IPv6 on the hotspot. The phone joined the hotspot, then every
  CarPlay connection was dropped ("connection to phone failed"). The mod now asks HMG-API for
  those ports (TCP and UDP, both ways) and ICMPv6 on the hotspot only (192.168.0.0/24 and
  link-local), while the **Wireless CarPlay** setting is on. HMG-API's network keeper owns the
  rules, puts them back after a stock firewall reset and removes them when the setting or mod
  is turned off. Needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer.

- `CEEV.CAN.0000.V016.010.260903` is accepted (new `ceev_ca_260903` patch set), so
  the mod no longer says "isn't for this head unit".
- The new patch set has **no result checksum for `featurexml.cfg`** yet: the stock
  file was not available. The engine still keeps the stock backup and restores it
  byte for byte, but it cannot refuse an unexpected result there.
- The patch set now lists the car's own library checksums, taken from a
  `CEEV.CAN.0000.V016.010.260903` car (rc.6; rc.5 had none).
- Merged Open-HMG `main` (2.2.0-rc.4): see
  [its notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.4).

## Checked against this firmware's libraries

From the libraries of a `CEEV.CAN.0000.V016.010.260903` car (checksums and the recipes'
own stock-byte checks; nothing was run on the car):

- `libautoreceiver_infobank.so` is the same file as on 260206 (`dbfe7bd2…`), so Android
  Auto turn-by-turn uses `aa-tbt-dbfe7bd2`; the other two `aa-tbt` recipes are for other
  builds and skip.
- `libCarPlayCore.so` is `ef49c09b…`: `carplay-core-frames-ef49c09b` fits it.
  `carplay-core-wifi` skips, as this build already takes Wi-Fi sessions.
- `libCarPlayAudio.so` (AAC and Opus offered on Wi-Fi) and `libiap2session.so` (the shared
  CarPlay identity) match their recipes' stock bytes, so both apply here.
- `libCarPlayUtils.so` (`e85385d7…`) already has the AAC and Opus converters built in,
  so `carplay-utils-converter` leaves it alone, as designed.

Nothing here has been tested on a car with this build.
